A well known organisation is looking for an experienced Personal Assistant to provide Administrative support to their CEO, this role manages executive administration, governance support, meeting coordination and document generation.

Part-time 3 days, 21hrs, per week 7.5 hours per day

title: Administrator - Export Team
salary_text: £13 per hour (Onsite Canteen, onsite convenience store, 26 day)
description:
We're looking for an Export Coordinator / Administrator to join a busy team, supporting the worldwide export of spares and repairs. You'll play an important role in ensuring shipments are processed accurately, on time and in line with customer requirements and export regulations. Based in Yeovil, this is a temporary role and the team currently work hybrid, 3 days in the office and 2 days at home (training will be full time in the office).
What you'll be doing:
- Coordinating worldwide exports of spares and repairs to customers and suppliers.
- Preparing export documentation to meet HM Revenue & Customs and Department for Business & Trade requirements, as well as customer-specific requirements.
- Producing shipping documents that comply with contractual and country-specific regulations.
- Ensuring documentation meets Letter of Credit requirements where applicable.
- Completing export entries using the GTS system where required.
- Monitoring customer orders to ensure goods are despatched on time and in line with agreed service levels.
- Acting as a point of contact for internal departments, responding to queries efficiently.
- Keeping stakeholders updated on shipment progress and delivery arrangements.
- Ensuring export procedures, including export licences and commodity codes, are followed correctly.
- Liaising with packing contractors to ensure goods are prepared for shipment within agreed timescales.
- Booking air, sea and road freight with freight forwarders and customer-appointed agents.
- Checking freight invoices against agreed rates before processing for payment.
- Maintaining accurate export records and departmental documentation.
- Ensuring shipping documentation is issued and distributed in line with company procedures.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.
- Supporting colleagues within the Export team and providing cover during periods of absence or increased workload.

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in an Export Coordinator, Shipping Administrator, Logistics Administrator or similar administration role.
- Experience within a shipping or distribution environment would be beneficial.
- Strong administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Good attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Confident using Microsoft Word, Excel and SAP (SAP is desirable)
- A proactive approach with a focus on delivering excellent customer service.

We are currently supporting a well-established and growing manufacturer to recruit a Customer Service Administrator. This is an exciting opportunity to join a customer focused organisation where service quality and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything they do.

As Customer Service Administrator, you will play a key role in delivering a high-quality warranty service, ensuring customers receive a seamless and efficient experience. - Log all communications and maintain accurate records using the CRM system
- Coordinate the dispatch of replacement parts and raise associated orders
- Arrange collections of faulty components in line with company procedures
- Authorise and organise service callouts in accordance with warranty terms
- Process invoices and manage documentation related to service visits
- Analyse service reports to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement
- Build and maintain effective relationships with external service partners

We're looking for an organised and proactive individual with excellent communication skills and a strong customer service mindset.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
- Proven ability to manage a varied workload and prioritise tasks effectively
- Strong administrative and organisational skills

title: Receptionist/Administration Assistant
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly organised Outpatient Receptionist/Administration Assistant to join our busy Outpatient Department for a 12 month fixed- term contract or secondment opportunity. As the first point of contact for patients, relatives, carers and visitors, you will provide a professional, welcoming and efficient reception and administrative service, helping to create a positive experience for everyone attending our services. You will play a vital role in supporting patient pathways, managing appointments, maintaining accurate patient records and ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of outpatient clinics. Working closely with clinical and administrative colleagues, you will contribute to the delivery of high-quality, compassionate and patient-centred care whilst supporting national and local performance standards. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong communication, customer service and administrative skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced healthcare environment. The successful candidate will: Provide a professional and friendly reception service for patients, relatives, carers and visitors. Welcome and check in patients attending outpatient appointments. Book, cancel and amend appointments in line with Trust policies and procedures. Prepare clinics and manage clinic lists to support efficient service delivery. Maintain accurate patient records using Trust electronic systems. Process clinic attendance outcomes, cancellations and DNA information. Respond to telephone, email and face-to-face enquiries in a timely and professional manner. Liaise with clinicians, nurses, GPs and other healthcare professionals to support patient care. Ensure patient demographic information is accurate and up to date. Monitor waiting areas and support patients throughout their outpatient journey. Handle confidential information in accordance with Information Governance and Data Protection requirements. Work flexibly as part of the wider administrative team to meet service needs and support continuous improvement initiatives. The full job description, person specification and main responsibilities for this role can be found in the attached Job Description document. The Outpatient Receptionist/Administration Assistant will provide a comprehensive reception and administrative support service across outpatient reception areas at Weston General Hospital, ensuring patients, relatives and visitors receive a professional, welcoming and efficient service. The post holder will support the smooth running of outpatient clinics through the effective management of appointments, patient records, clinic administration and reception duties, whilst maintaining the highest standards of customer service, confidentiality and data quality. Applicants are encouraged to read the attached Job Description and Person Specification carefully, which provide full details of the duties, responsibilities and requirements of this post.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for friendly, organised and enthusiastic Receptionists to join our team at Penn Hill Surgery. We have re-organised our reception and secretarial teams to increase our numbers in reception in order to provide the best service to our patients whilst making the role more varied for staff. We are looking for two part time receptionists to share the vacancy hours. The hours would ideally be worked in the following regular shift patterns: Two part-time positions: Vacancy 1 = 17 hours or Vacancy 2 = 22.25 hours Vacancy 1 working pattern : Mon 10:00-18:30, Tues 08:30-13:00 & Weds 13:00-17:30 = 17 hours p/wk Vacancy 2 working pattern : Mon 08:30-13:00, Thurs 08:30-17:30, Fri 08:30-18:30 = 22.25 hours p/wk We are happy to discuss working patterns with suitable candidates. Please note that applicants must be able to work our core reception shifts, including 8:30am starts and some 6:30pm finishes. We are proud of our hardworking, experienced and supportive team, where colleagues work together to provide excellent patient care. Whether you already have experience in general practice or are looking for a new challenge, we will provide full training and support. If you would enjoy a fast-paced role where no two days are the same, can juggle a variety of tasks and enjoy helping people, we would love to hear from you. You'll be joining a supportive team and making a difference to our patients every day. For an informal discussion, please contact Karen Tucker, the Deputy Practice Manager. Provide an efficient, professional and welcoming reception service to patients, visitors and other healthcare professionals. Answer telephone calls, deal with general enquiries, explain practice procedures, signpost patients to the most appropriate clinician or service, and accurately relay messages when required. Book, amend and cancel appointments using practice systems, ensuring patients with urgent clinical needs are managed appropriately using sound judgement and established procedures. Accurately register new and temporary patients, process deductions and maintain patient records using EMIS. Action and complete tasks received through EMIS, AskMyGP and email on a daily basis. Scan and accurately code clinical correspondence onto patients' electronic medical records. Explain practice services and registration requirements to patients and ensure all relevant documentation is completed. Process payments for private (non-NHS) services, issue receipts and maintain accurate financial records. Work closely with clinical and administrative colleagues to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and deliver excellent patient care. Medical records summarising MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST Hours: We welcome applications from candidates interested in the following two sets of hours: Vacancy 1: Mon 10:00-18:30, Tues 08:30-13:00 and Weds 13:00-17:30 = 17 hours p/wk Vacancy 2 : Mon 08:30-13:00, Thurs 08:30-17:30 and Fri 08:30-18:30 = 22.25 hours p/wk Place of Work: Penn Hill Surgery Reports to: Deputy Practice Manager Job Summary We are looking for friendly, organised and enthusiastic individuals to join our hardworking and supportive Reception Team. We have increased the hours in the reception team in order to provide greater variety in the day-to-day administrative duties, creating a rewarding role that combines reception responsibilities with a range of administrative tasks. Reception is at the heart of our practice and is often the first point of contact for our patients. This is a busy, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. The successful candidates will enjoy working with people, be able to manage a variety of competing demands, remain calm under pressure and provide a professional, compassionate service to our patients. Whether you have previous experience working in general practice or are looking for a new challenge, we will provide the training and support needed to help you develop in the role. You will work closely with our clinical and administrative teams to ensure patients receive the highest standard of care while contributing to the smooth running of the practice. Main Responsibilities Reception Provide a professional, friendly and efficient reception service to patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. Answer telephone calls, deal with general enquiries and signpost patients to the most appropriate clinician or service. Book, amend and cancel appointments using practice systems. Use your judgement and communication skills to ensure patients requiring urgent medical attention are managed appropriately in accordance with practice procedures. Explain practice services, registration procedures and temporary patient arrangements. Maintain accurate patient records using EMIS. Check and update patient demographic details as required. Process payments for private (non-NHS) services and issue receipts. Administration As well as reception duties, you'll also undertake a variety of administrative tasks, including: Actioning tasks received via EMIS, AskMyGP and email. Processing new patient registrations, temporary registrations and deductions. Scanning and coding clinical correspondence onto patients' electronic records. Supporting the wider practice team with general administrative duties to help ensure the smooth running of the practice. Summary patient medical records. Premises Prepare the surgery for the start of the working day. Secure the premises at the end of the day when required, ensuring practice procedures are followed. General Responsibilities Attend team meetings, staff meetings and mandatory training. Participate in service improvement initiatives. Maintain confidentiality at all times in accordance with GDPR, NHS guidance and Practice policies. Work flexibly and undertake other duties appropriate to the role as requested by the Partners or Management Team.
